_source: The owner's homebrew, content/classes/blood-bending.json: the level table's own features, not a path's. A pool there names the ability that spends it (`ability`), and the pool exists only while this document does (rules/classes.py apply).
_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. The engine reads these fields and never these names.

abilities.name: Rapid Coagulation
abilities.source: content/classes/blood-bending.json pools: 'Once per combat, regain 1d10+Con.' The class names no action; a swift action is assumed, as for the class's other self-mending (Siphon Pool) — the owner's call.
abilities.text: Regain 1d10 + Con hit points, once a fight.

abilities.name: Unbalancing Strike
abilities.source: content/classes/blood-bending.json features and the author's .docx: 'Declared before making an attack roll. A foe damaged by your unarmed attack must make a Fortitude save (DC ) or become Flat-Footed until just before your next turn. Usable 1/day for every 4 levels + CON modifier.' The DC was lost from the .docx; 10 + 1/2 level + Con is the class's own formula for its other saves (Blood Burst), inferred. Written the Stunning Fist way (a charge the next unarmed swing spends; a miss wastes it). Before 2026-11-26 it had no document, so its pool was never made and the name was refused.
abilities.text: Your next unarmed hit: Fortitude save or flat-footed until your next turn.
abilities.tell: {name} sets the next blow to knock the foe off balance.

abilities.name: Stunning Strike
abilities.source: content/classes/blood-bending.json features and the author's .docx: 'Declared before making an attack roll. A foe damaged by your unarmed attack must make a Fortitude save (DC ) or be Stunned for 1 round. Usable 1/day for every 4 levels + CON modifier.' DC inferred as Unbalancing Strike's; the immunities are Stunning Fist's (CRB), which this is written against.
abilities.text: Your next unarmed hit: Fortitude save or stunned for a round.
abilities.tell: {name} gathers the blood into the next blow.
